decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are thermoforming materials for dental labs, which is the firm's core knowledge, and they have their own product page, so in-house R&D can interpret early results and refine them.
A PETG thermoforming blank extends the firm's established thermoforming material range, so its related knowledge and own R&D strongly support assimilation and improvement.
A UV-curing lacquer fits the firm's light-curing materials expertise for dental and earmold work, though it is only mentioned on the website and so carries modestly more risk.
An intraoral contrast spray supports the digital scanning workflows the firm is moving toward and has its own page, but it is a consumable somewhat outside core device-making, giving moderate risk.
Custom earmolds are a core competence in hearing-care custom-device manufacturing, so the firm can readily learn from results even though the line is only mentioned online.
Custom hearing protection earmolds build directly on the firm's earmold know-how and digital production, so absorptive capacity favours keeping them.
